titulo: Ten tasks and go to sleep
lead: With the bot running, your paper queue becomes messages. Each line is a skill with an input; the bot puts each request in the right queue, runs it within that skill’s limits, and lets you know in the chat when it’s done.
objetivo: send 5 to 10 tasks in skill format and track the batch with /fila and /jobs.
hero_alt: A hand holding a phone with messages sent one after another, with a blurred monitor in the background.

aprende.t: The format of a request: skill, input, and fields
The five queues and why the render queue runs one at a time
What not to do while the batch is running

secoes.titulo: From a message to a notification
secoes.sub: The path each batch request takes.

nos.detalhe: One line per task. The name before the colon is the skill; the input comes after it; optional fields go after a vertical bar.
The bot looks up the skill in the catalog. It lists which queue the skill runs in, the maximum deadline, and how many attempts it gets. A skill that isn’t in the catalog is rejected right away.
Each queue has its own limit. All ten video requests can be added, but the render queue runs one at a time because they share the graphics card.
The worker builds the skill prompt with your input and calls the agent. It works on its own, without asking for confirmation, and ends with RESULT or ERRO.
When it finishes, the bot sends the result or the reason for failure in the chat. In the morning, the conversation is your report.

secoes.legenda: Click each block. Queue and limit numbers come from the inemaccbot documentation.

rolagem_fim.texto: You send the whole list at once. The bot distributes tasks across queues, respects the limits, and replies to each one when it’s done.

secoes.titulo: How to write and track the batch

texto: <skill>: <input> [| field]. The input is what you put in the "Input" column of your queue on paper.
/skills lists the installed skills, and /ajuda <skill> shows each skill’s fields. A field written without the bar is rejected; it won’t silently become part of the input.

exemplo.texto: explicativo: what is a durable queue | vertical

passos.titulo: Fields that apply to all skills
texto: | modelo=haiku and | esforco=high change the model and reasoning for that request only. | motor=codex runs that request through codex instead of claude.
Use these to test one request. The effective model is recorded in the job, so in the morning you know what was used for each result.
/fila shows, for each queue, what’s running, how many are waiting, their age, errors from the last 24 hours, and retries. /jobs lists jobs that are running and those that are finished.
/status j13 gives you details about a job. A number alone always means a job; a letter and # (A#9) means a flow, covered in the next lesson.
/furar j13 moves a pending job to the front of the queue. /cancelar j13 stops a pending or running job.
Canceling applies to the queue, not the world: anything already created outside it (a delivered file, a published video) stays there.

passos.titulo: Don’t restart while the batch is running
texto: If a job fails with code 143, it wasn’t the agent: the service restarted in the middle (143 = 128 + 15, the shutdown signal). The job goes back in the queue if it has attempts left; otherwise, it fails.
A render takes 10 to 15 min. Two restarts in a row can use up both attempts for the same job. Before restarting or updating, check that the queue is empty.

exercicios.titulo: E4 · Ten tasks and go to sleep
exercicios.texto: Send the bot 5 to 10 tasks from your list (transcribe, summarize, explainer…). Check /fila once, then go do something else. Don’t restart the bot until the queue is empty.
exercicios.pronto: `/fila` showed the distributed batch, and the next day, each task has a reply in the chat (result or reason for failure).

secoes.fonte: The morning check is lesson 7. Original exercise: 03-filas.md (E4).

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: You sent four explainer video requests. Why is only one showing as running?
opcoes: The render queue runs one job at a time on purpose because it shares the graphics card.
The bot only accepts one message at a time.
The subscription hasn’t been paid for.
perguntas.explica: All four are saved; the render queue limit is 1. The others wait their turn, and /fila shows how many are waiting.

perguntas.p: A job failed with code 143. What does that indicate?
opcoes: The service restarted while the job was running.
The disk ran out of space.
perguntas.explica: 143 is the shutdown signal. Check the queue before restarting. The work wasn’t corrupted; it just didn’t finish, and you can run it again.

perguntas.p: You want to try a cheaper model for just one request. How?
opcoes: Change the default model in .env and restart.
perguntas.explica: The field applies only to that job and is saved with it. Changing .env would affect everything and require a restart, which could put the current batch at risk.
